posts.title: When Protests Turn to Riots
posts.caption:
Always wanted to discuss current news stories with your students but don't know how to?
We've got you.

This week:
- When Protests Turn to Riots (full lesson, ages 11-16): Should someone break the law if they think the law itself is unjust?
- Fast-moving California wildfire (lite pack, ages 11-14): If climate change is making wildfires more dangerous, who is responsible for protecting people?
- Screen Time in Schools: Are We Damaging Our Health? (full lesson, ages 11-14): When doctors and teachers disagree about what is best for students?

Three ways to start (all links are also in our bio):
1. Free for your whole department until January 2027 (10 staff logins, no payment details): email p4cnewsroom@gmail.com | one-page overview: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mboZVEJbuO9_usB2t-My_C8BLrq_JiRD/view?usp=sharing
2. Two free packs every week: https://forms.gle/P3gsBgMv54qvZf6r8
3. Single stories on TES: https://www.tes.com/teaching-resources/shop/p4cnewsroom
